senses.gloss:
ग्लेप (ऋ) ग्लेपृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेपते)
 1. To be poor or dependent.
 2. To shake
to tremble.
 3. To move. सक-भ्वा-आ-सेट् ।

ग्लेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be made weary or exhausted, exhaustible,
fatiguable.
 E. ग्ला or ग्लै to be weary, affix यत्.

ग्लेव (ऋ) ग्लेवृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेवते) To serve, to worship, to gratify by
service or devotedness. भ्वा-आ-सक-सेट् ।
ग्लेष (ऋ) ग्लषृ r. 1st cl (ग्लेषते) To inquire, to search, to investigate.
